text:
Nina (People Ops): FYI courier left a long parcel and a folded e-scooter at the desk for our 2pm visitor (Ms. Park). Parcel tag says 'UTL-204', scooter sticker 'FOLD-X'. Lobby's a bit tight. Can someone advise storage + badge name?

Owen (Front Desk): Logged items UTL-204 and FOLD-X. Currently on the bench by the door. Ms. Park isn't showing up under that name in the calendar  whos the host?

Marco: That's my guest  meeting shows "City Mobility demo" at 14:00. I'll be down at 13:50 to help move the scooter. Please badge as 'S. Park (Guest of Marco)'.

Diego (Facilities): Heads up  if the scooter has a lithium battery we shouldn't store or charge it in the lobby. Can someone check the label? If it's removable I'll move the battery to the designated battery locker.

PackageBot: UTL-204 scanned at 13:12. Photo: pkg_1845009951.jpg. Delivery note: "left at front desk". FOLD-X scanned at 13:14. Sticker: "Battery: removable".

Owen (Front Desk): I checked  battery is removable and labeled "Li-ion". Holding scooter upright on the cart for now.

Nina (People Ops): OK let's move scooter to Storage D (we use D4 for battery-containing devices) and label the battery separately. @Diego can you help move? Also printing a one-time badge now.

Diego (Facilities): On it. Will bring a trolley and move scooter to Storage D4 in two. Ill place battery in Battery Locker B1 and tag it FOLD-X-BATT. No charging in lobby.

SafetyBot: Reminder: Battery storage policy requires terminals taped and battery logged in safety binder.

Marco: Thanks  I'll tape terminals when I pick it up. Also can we reserve the accessible armchair near the demo wall for Ms. Park? She requested extra legroom.

Owen (Front Desk): Reserved armchair and labeled "Guest - S. Park". Printed badge as 'S. Park (Guest of Marco)'. Please have ID ready when they arrive.

Ms. Park: Arrived early. At front desk now. ID scanned and signed at 13:56. Owen handed badge and wifi code.

Diego (Facilities): Scooter moved to Storage D4, battery in B1 labeled FOLD-X-BATT, terminals taped, logged in safety binder under entry 1845-03. Cart returned.

Owen (Front Desk): All set in lobby: armchair reserved, scooter secured off-aisle, badge issued. Ms. Park seated and comfortable.

Nina (People Ops): Great teamwork  thanks everyone for the quick handling and safety checks. I'll add a short note to the vendor checklist to include 'battery removable?' on future device deliveries.

Marco: Appreciate it  we're good to start the demo at 14:05.

Ms. Park: Thanks all!
